label: What every prompt that writes SPOKEN text tells the model (one place for all of them)

params.name: for_ear
params.default: Everything you write for a voice will be SPOKEN by a text-to-speech model. Write for the ear: full sentences, never bare lists of names or terms; spell every name and word in its normal spelling - never phonetic re-spellings, hyphenated syllables or IPA; write numbers, symbols and abbreviations the way they are said.

params.name: no_sound_split
params.label: When the voice model returns no sound for a line, it is asked again one sentence at a time (this pattern splits the sentences)

description_nl: 2026-09-30 (owner: "Gemini returned no audio ... update LLM Bridge and Draft with AI and any other places"): the premium voice (Gemini TTS) returned NO SOUND for bare lists of terms and for hyphenated phonetic re-spellings. Every prompt whose answer is spoken - Avatar and Doodly scenes (doodle.script_prompt), Video narration (narrator.build_prompt, translate), film dialogue (pending.dialogue_prompt) - appends this, via media.for_ear().
